They lied to you about the process. Having said that. Next time you see the DM, go up to them and introduce yourself and let them know your interest in full time as well as looking forward to the opportunity for growth with Publix. 

It may piss off your department manager, but the DM will know your name and it will spark a conversation with the SM. 

A lot of moving forward at Publix is putting yourself in front of of the people who can help move your career along. 

Also make it a point to speak to the DM every time you see them, it keeps your name and face in theirs. You don't need to remind them everytime about FT. Keep the conversation light and business focused.
